steps.do: Decide eligible_for_provisional_credit using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines. All criteria must hold: account open at least 60 days (get_accounts open date vs get_time); reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, or goods_services_not_received with the purchase more than 30 days ago; amount at least $25.00 and no more than the card tier's maximum; no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months (check_dispute_history); merchant contacted for non-fraud. If any criterion fails, set it to false.

rules.rule: Provisional credit is true only if ALL of these hold: the account has been open at least 60 days; the reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, or goods_services_not_received with the purchase more than 30 days ago; the amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the tier maximum; no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; and, for non-fraud disputes, the merchant was contacted first
rules.quote: ## Eligibility Criteria — Customer is ELIGIBLE for provisional credit if ALL of the following are true:

rules.rule: The reasons incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging and refund_never_processed are never eligible for provisional credit
rules.quote: - Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'

rules.rule: Mid tier cards (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) have a provisional credit maximum of $5000.00. Other tiers: Entry $2500, Premium $10000, Elite $15000, Diamond Elite $25000.
rules.quote: - Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00

rules.rule: Use cancel_and_reissue only when the customer wants the card replaced; otherwise use keep_active
rules.quote: - 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced - whether you've already ordered a replacement card via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation is happening as part of this dispute)

rules.rule: partial_refund_amount is passed only when resolution_requested is partial_refund
rules.quote: 14. partial_refund_amount (number, optional) - Only required if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund'. The dollar amount for the partial refund.

rules.rule: If the customer lacks the last 4 digits, give them the get_card_last_4_digits user tool instead of walking them through the steps
rules.quote: - Providing this tool replaces any step‑by‑step process for obtaining the last four digits.

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires the credit card account to have been open for at least 60 days (open date from get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, compared with get_current_time)
rules.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

rules.rule: goods_services_not_received is eligible only when the purchase was made more than 30 days ago
rules.quote: 'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)

rules.rule: The transaction amount must be >= $25.00 and <= the card tier's maximum
rules.quote: 3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)

rules.rule: Not eligible if the customer filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months (from get_user_dispute_history_7291)
rules.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: For any reason other than unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, provisional credit requires contacted_merchant = true
rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

rules.rule: Ordering a replacement cancels the old card automatically, so order one only when the customer wants the card replaced
rules.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and the verification is logged. file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 has been called successfully for the confirmed transaction with all required arguments, including a correctly determined eligible_for_provisional_credit and the customer's chosen card_action (with a replacement ordered first if they chose cancel_and_reissue and are eligible). The customer has been told the dispute is filed and whether provisional credit applies. Otherwise, a failure has been explained and a transfer was offered.

open_questions: No document says whether the agent must apply provisional credit separately (for example with a statement credit) or whether the dispute tool handles it. The workflow only passes the flag.
No document says what to do if the disputed transaction already has an open dispute in the history.
No document makes contacting the merchant a precondition for filing. The workflow files anyway with contacted_merchant=false.
The replacement eligibility rules referenced by the replacement procedure were not traced here; the replacement branch defers to that procedure.
No document says whether the account and transaction records show the card's last 4 digits.

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires the credit card account to have been open for at least 60 days
rules.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

rules.rule: Provisional credit only for unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, or goods_services_not_received with the purchase more than 30 days ago
rules.quote: - 'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)

rules.rule: No provisional credit for incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging or refund_never_processed
rules.quote: - Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'

rules.rule: Amount must be >= $25.00 and <= the tier maximum
rules.quote: 3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)

rules.rule: Tier maximums: Entry $2500.00, Mid (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $5000.00, Premium $10000.00, Elite $15000.00, Invitation $25000.00
rules.quote: - Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00

rules.rule: Not eligible if more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months
rules.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: For non-fraud reasons, provisional credit requires contacted_merchant = true
rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

rules.rule: partial_refund_amount is passed only when resolution_requested is partial_refund
rules.quote: 14. partial_refund_amount (number, optional) - Only required if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund'. The dollar amount for the partial refund.

rules.rule: Ordering a replacement cancels the old card, so use cancel_and_reissue only when the customer wants the card replaced
rules.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

draft.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, and file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 has returned success for the confirmed transaction with every required argument. The customer has been told the dispute was filed and whether provisional credit applies. Alternatively, a failure has been explained and a transfer was offered.
